      - heading "Symmetry vs Reflexivity" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "Symmetric (may or may not be reflexive) R = {(1,2), (2,1)} ✓ Symmetric × Not reflexive"
      - paragraph: "Reflexive (may or may not be symmetric) R = {(1,1), (2,2)} ✓ Reflexive × Not symmetric"
    - article:
      - heading "Exact Definition" [level=3]
      - paragraph: A relation R on a set A is symmetric if
      - strong: aRb ⇒ bRa for all a,b ∈ A
      - paragraph: "Equivalently: (a,b) ∈ R ⇒ (b,a) ∈ R"
